image_description: A vintage comic book cover featuring a dynamic action scene with two characters in combat. One character, wearing a green and white uniform, is being struck or thrown by a larger figure in red armor. The background includes explosive effects (yellow/orange bursts) and stylized text elements typical of comic book lettering. The image exhibits signs of age, such as slight discoloration and wear.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text within the yellow caption box on the right is illegible/gibberish. While this mimics the look of low-resolution scans of old comics, the character shapes are nonsensical rather than just blurry, suggesting potential AI generation artifacting or severe degradation that obscures semantic content.

The hands of the character in green are somewhat indistinct and blend into the clothing/background. The fingers lack clear definition, appearing slightly 'melted' or poorly rendered, which is common in both low-quality prints and AI generations.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-genre or era of the comic book and verify it aligns with the 'comic book' class label against potential look-alikes (e.g., illustrated posters).
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text in the yellow box and title. AI often fails to render coherent text, whereas real comics have specific font styles.
To distinguish between natural aging artifacts (paper yellowing, scan noise) and AI-generated structural inconsistencies or unnatural blurring.
To check for edge bleeding between the characters and the background/explosions, ensuring they are distinct entities.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic coherence of the text in the yellow caption box.
Anatomical correctness of the characters' hands and limbs.
Consistency of the artistic style (line work, shading) across the entire cover.
Distinction between scan-induced noise and AI-generation artifacts.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text in the yellow box. If the OCR expert finds no recognizable words or inconsistent character spacing, this is a strong indicator of AI generation, even if the visual style mimics a vintage comic. Also, scrutinize the interaction between the red and green characters; look for 'smudging' where their bodies meet, which might indicate fusion artifacts.
